global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with visible fat swirls. Topped with chashu pork, menma, and shredded greens, it sits in a patterned bowl on a wooden table, lit warmly to highlight the steam and textures.

regions.background: Wooden table surface, smooth with visible grain patterns and warm brown tones, slightly reflective under ambient light.
regions.bowl: The ceramic ramen bowl has a white interior, black patterned rim, and glossy finish with intricate repeating designs.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy white, thick, and glossy, with visible noodles and toppings floating on its surface.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and elongated, curved shape.
regions.meat: The chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with a glossy surface and a distinct circular bone marrow center.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear golden-brown, with fibrous texture and irregular, slightly curled shapes, showing subtle surface ridges.
